text:
Akshay: quick q — when a region gets ejected we still see a bunch of in-flight requests getting routed there for ~30s. Can we make gateway honor an `x-prefetch-kv` hint so warm-standby nodes prefetch KV while new requests prefer local first?
Denise: ahh yeah saw this in canary. The region ejection sets a short TTL but probes still hit ejected zone until the probe actor drains.
Maya: what's the desired semantics? stop routing new traffic to ejected region entirely, or continue a tiny warm window for cache population?
Akshay: prefer-local-then-warm-standby: new traffic should prefer local (region affinity). But if header `x-kv-prefetch: yes` is present, route a small fraction (2%) to standby nodes to prime KV caches.
Jen: makes sense. We should expose the sampling rate via rollout flags. Also need telemetry: counters for "kv_prefetch_sent", "kv_prefetch_hit" per region.
infra-bot: deploy triggered: edge-probe-service -> v2.4.1; canary 3 nodes
Ricardo: note: adding `x-kv-prefetch` to user requests is risky; better generated by router when it sees a cache-miss signal from the app. Could also be internal header only: `x-internal-kv-prefetch`.
Denise: agree on internal header. Also need a circuit-breaker so prefetch attempts don't exhaust standby capacity. `max_prefetch_inflight` at the route config.
Akshay: draft route config snippet:
```
route:
  match: /v1/generate
  routing:
    prefer_local: true
    prefetch_hint_header: x-internal-kv-prefetch
    prefetch_sample_pct: 2
    max_prefetch_inflight: 50
```
Maya: +1 — UX note: Console should show prefetch sampling and `prefetch_inflight` gauge per region. Also make rollouts able to set different sample_pct per customer tier.
Jen: telemetry: expose histograms: prefetch_latency_ms, prefetch_success_rate and link to per-customer quotas so we can blame if it spikes costs.
Ricardo: ops ask — when a region is ejected, should fallback go to next region immediately or allow short grace for probes? Current probe TTL is 15s, maybe bump to 30s but make configurable per-route.
Denise: maybe add `grace_window_ms` in routing policy so ejected regions keep serving only existing connections for that window, but new requests follow prefer_local:false.
Akshay: sounds good. I'll open a RFC and a tiny POC. Can people react with :+1: if they want to be on the RFC review? 
Maya: :+1:
Jen: :+1:
Ricardo: :+1:
infra-bot: RFC created: rfc/2026-03-prefetch-routing.md
